20	import type { PostToolDecision, ToolExecution, ToolExecutionToken } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
21	import { SpillLocator, SpillStore } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-spill'

26	const testToolSignal = new AbortController().signal

28	/** A stub spill backend recording its saves; `fail` exercises the best-effort fallback. */
29	class StubStore extends SpillStore {
30	  saves: SaveTextSpill[] = []
31	  fail = false
32	  /** Per-save hang hook: each call awaits the returned promise before completing. */
33	  gate: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined
34	
35	  async saveText(input: SaveTextSpill): Promise<SpillRef> {
36	    if (this.fail) throw new Error('disk full')
37	    await this.gate?.()
38	    this.saves.push(input)
39	    return {
40	      locator: SpillLocator(`/spill/${input.suggestedName}`),
41	      bytes: Buffer.byteLength(input.content, 'utf8'),
42	      retrievalHint: 'Use the stub retrieval path.',
43	    }
44	  }
45	}

47	/** A tool returning `text` verbatim (name configurable so we can register `read`). */
48	function textTool(name: string, text: string) {
49	  return defineContentToolFixture({
50	    name,
51	    description: name,
52	    parameters: {},
53	    async execute(): Promise<ContentBlock[]> { return [{ type: 'text', text }] },
54	  })
55	}
56	
57	/** A minimal exec carrying a session header id (the spill owner). */
58	function exec(name: string, session = 's1'): ToolExecution {
59	  // Only agent.session.header.id is read by the policy; a structural stub suffices.
60	  const agent = { session: { header: { id: SessionId(session) } } }
61	  return { callId: ToolCallId(`call-${name}`), name, arguments: {}, agent, signal: testToolSignal } as unknown as ToolExecution
62	}

64	/**
65	 * Build a context with tools + the policy, and optionally a spill backend.
66	 * Returns the context and the backend handle (undefined when `withSpill` false).
67	 */
68	async function setup(
69	  config: SpillPolicy.Config,
70	  withSpill = true,
71	  beforePolicy?: (ctx: Context) => void,
72	): Promise<{ ctx: Context; spill?: StubStore; fiber: Awaited<ReturnType<Context['plugin']>> }> {
73	  const ctx = new Context()
74	  await ctx.plugin(SystemPrompt)
75	  await ctx.plugin(ToolRuntime)
76	  let spill: StubStore | undefined
77	  if (withSpill) {
78	    await ctx.plugin(StubStore)
79	    spill = ctx.spillStore as StubStore
80	  }
81	  beforePolicy?.(ctx)
82	  const fiber = await ctx.plugin(SpillPolicy, config)
83	  return { ctx, fiber, ...spill ? { spill } : {} }
84	}

86	/** Flatten a result's text blocks. */
87	function textOf(content: ContentBlock[]): string {
88	  return content.filter((b): b is Extract<ContentBlock, { type: 'text' }> => b.type === 'text').map(b => b.text).join('')
89	}

127	describe('oversized plain-text replacement', () => {
128	  it('spills the full text and replaces the result with a preview + locator within the cap', async () => {
129	    const { ctx, spill } = await setup({ maxInlineBytes: 200 })
130	    const body = 'HEAD'.repeat(200) + 'TAIL'.repeat(200) // 1600 bytes > 200
131	    ctx.tools.register(textTool('big', body))
132	    const result = await ctx.tools.execute(exec('big'))
133	
134	    expect(result.isError).toBe(false)
135	    expect(spill?.saves).toHaveLength(1)
136	    expect(spill?.saves[0]?.content).toBe(body)
137	    expect(spill?.saves[0]?.source.toolName).toBe('big')
138	    expect(spill?.saves[0]?.suggestedName).toBe('big.txt')
139	    expect(spill?.saves[0]?.owner.sessionId).toBe('s1')
140	
141	    const text = textOf(result.content)
142	    expect(text).not.toBe(body)
143	    expect(text.startsWith('HEAD')).toBe(true)
144	    expect(text).toContain('Full formatted result stored at: /spill/big.txt')
145	    expect(text).toContain('Use the stub retrieval path.')
146	    expect(text).toContain('Omitted')
147	    // The replacement (preview + blank line + notice) stays within the cap and
148	    // is smaller than the original — the whole point of spilling.
149	    expect(Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8')).toBeLessThanOrEqual(200)
150	    expect(Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8')).toBeLessThan(body.length)
151	  })
152	
153	  it('keeps the inline result when the notice-only replacement would exceed the cap', async () => {
154	    // A body just over a tiny cap: the notice alone is larger than the cap, so
155	    // there is no within-cap replacement — the policy keeps the inline result.
156	    const { ctx } = await setup({ maxInlineBytes: 4 })
157	    const warn = vi.spyOn(ctx.logger, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => { })
158	    const body = 'xxxxx' // 5 bytes > 4, but far shorter than the notice
159	    ctx.tools.register(textTool('big', body))
160	    const result = await ctx.tools.execute(exec('big'))
161	    expect(textOf(result.content)).toBe(body)
